object.attr: derived: a misspelt `--read-only` that is ignored gives a read-write server where the person chose read-only (CF-M1, review Q21). The failure analysis proposed status 2 (D-M6), but 2 already means an unusable root, so the review left the status open; it is pinned after testing 0.3.0.
